content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary objective lacks estimand specification",
      "quote": "The primary objective of the study is to assess the efficacy of REGN3500 monotherapy in atopic dermatitis (AD), as well as understand the dose-response relationship, compared with placebo treatment, in adult patients with moderate-to-severe AD.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary objective does not specify the estimand (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) as required by ICH M11 and SPIRIT 2025.",
      "fix": "Add a formal estimand section specifying the target population, endpoint definition, handling of intercurrent events (e.g., rescue treatment, discontinuation), and population-level summary."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent dosing schedule for 30 mg Q8W group",
      "quote": "REGN3500 30 mg SC Q8W: 1 injection of REGN3500 (30 mg total dose) plus 2 injections of REGN3500-matching placebo administered SC on day 1 and week 8; and 2 injections of REGN3500-matching placebo administered SC at weeks 2, 4, 6, 10, 12, and 14.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "6.3",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The Q8W regimen states active drug only on day 1 and week 8, but the treatment period extends to week 14. This means the last active dose is at week 8, and the patient receives only placebo for the final 6 weeks, which is inconsistent with a Q8W schedule (should have doses at weeks 8 and 16, but week 16 is end of treatment). Clarify if the last active dose is at week 8 or if there is a missing dose at week 14.",
      "fix": "Specify the exact timing of the last active dose for the 30 mg Q8W group, and ensure it aligns with the Q8W frequency (e.g., doses at day 1, week 8, and possibly week 16 if treatment extends)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Rescue treatment rules conflict with primary endpoint analysis",
      "quote": "If rescue treatment consists of systemic corticosteroids or non-steroidal systemic immunosuppressive drugs, study treatment will be permanently discontinued immediately.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "6.5",
      "category": "amendment_risk",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe how rescue treatment is handled in the primary estimand (e.g., whether data after rescue are treated as intercurrent events, and whether the primary analysis uses a treatment policy or hypothetical strategy). This could lead to ambiguity in the analysis and potential amendments.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand strategy for rescue treatment in the statistical analysis section, and specify whether the primary endpoint uses data after rescue or imputes missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing contraception requirements",
      "quote": "Male or female adult patients (≥18 to 75 years of age) with moderate-to-severe AD",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "5.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify contraception requirements for male and female participants of childbearing potential, which is a regulatory and ethical requirement for a clinical trial with an investigational drug.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception section specifying acceptable methods, duration of use, and pregnancy testing requirements."
    },
    {
      "title": "No trial stopping rules specified",
      "quote": "The end of the study for this study is defined as the last visit of the last patient.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks explicit trial stopping rules (e.g., for safety, futility, or overwhelming efficacy). This is a critical element for a phase 2b dose-ranging study.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination due to safety concerns or futility, and the process for decision-making."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent visit schedule for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The end-of-treatment visit will occur at week 16, which is 2 weeks after the last dose of study drug. The primary endpoint will be evaluated at week 16.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "4.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text says the last dose is at week 14, but the end-of-treatment visit is at week 16, which is 2 weeks after the last dose. However, the treatment period is described as 16 weeks, and the last dose is at week 14. This is inconsistent: if the treatment period is 16 weeks, the last dose should be at week 16, or the end-of-treatment visit should be at week 14. Clarify the exact timing.",
      "fix": "Clarify the treatment period duration and the timing of the last dose and end-of-treatment visit. If the last dose is at week 14, the end-of-treatment visit should be at week 14 or the treatment period should be extended to week 16."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing details on rescue treatment and study drug discontinuation",
      "quote": "If rescue treatment consists of systemic corticosteroids or non-steroidal systemic immunosuppressive drugs, study treatment will be permanently discontinued immediately.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "7.1.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify whether patients who discontinue study drug due to rescue treatment remain in the study for follow-up, and how their data are handled in the analysis. This is a common source of ambiguity.",
      "fix": "Add a section on permanent discontinuation of study intervention, including whether patients continue in the study for follow-up and the implications for the estimand."
    },
    {
      "title": "No mention of data sharing or patient and public involvement",
      "quote": "Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Page 6 of 83",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "11.12",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include any statement on data sharing or patient and public involvement, which are required by SPIRIT 2025 and ICH M11.",
      "fix": "Add sections on data sharing (including plans for sharing de-identified data) and patient and public involvement (including how patients were involved in trial design)."
    }
  ]
}
